const getGradeColor = (grade) => { const colors = { 'K': 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800', '1': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800', '2': 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800', '3': 'bg-green-100 text-green-800', '4': 'bg-green-100 text-green-800', '5': 'bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800', '6': 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-800', '7': 'bg-red-100 text-red-800', '8': 'bg-red-100 text-red-800', '9': 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800', '10': 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800', '11': 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800', '12': 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800' }; return colors[grade] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-800'; }; const getAge = (dateOfBirth) => { const today = new Date(); const birthDate = new Date(dateOfBirth); let age = today.getFullYear() - birthDate.getFullYear();
